_comment: Every published claim, with where it is stated and how to check it.
tools/reproduce_all.sh measures them and tools/reproduce_report.py prints
claim against measurement. `tolerance` is absolute, in the value's units;
counts use 0. When a claim changes, change it here in the same commit as
the document, or the reproduction reports a mismatch.
